title: Bubipack (server)
description: The server-side counterpart to Bubipack — install this on your server so clients running Bubipack can connect.
body:
This is the server-side version of Bubipack.

If you and your friends want to play Bubipack together on a dedicated server, install this modpack on the server. Clients should install the regular Bubipack modpack.

🖥️ Server-Side Only
This modpack contains only the mods necessary to run the server. Client-only mods (FPS optimizations, UI improvements, etc.) are not included here.

🔧 Create & Addons
Full Create support so all contraptions and automation work correctly in multiplayer.



The client modpack can be found here: [Bubipack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/bubipack)
